title: Hold the Seventh
setup: Black's king holds e8 in front of the pawn, and the white king is ready to march up past it.
hint: Find the rank your rook can hold, from which it can check the white king the moment it steps up.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rd7}} takes the seventh rank away from the white king, and the try {{Kf6}} is answered by {{Rf7+}}, driving it straight back: your king on e8 guards the rook. From any lower square on the d-file White walks in with {{Ke6}} instead, and {{Rd6}} even hangs to {{exd6}}.
